sources.name: Pakistan Stock Exchange - Data Portal
sources.review_notes: PSX Terms of Use (reviewed 2026-11-07) prohibit robots/spiders and 'systematic retrieval to create collections, compilations, databases or directories' without PSX's prior written permission. Announcements are loaded by JavaScript; no public feed. Requires written permission or a PSX data licence (Data Services & Vending). The Phase 1 company master was compiled from 51 profile pages read once on 2026-11-07; see docs/SOURCE_ACCESS_REGISTER.md. PR #7 findings: announcement pages are protected by reCAPTCHA; PSX directs data requests to marketdatarequest@psx.com.pk (Data Services & Vending). Registration of provider routes does not permit collection.
sources.notes: Company profiles and KSE-30 list read on 2026-11-07 to seed the company master. Terms of use to be reviewed before any collector (Phase 2).

sources.name: SCS Trade chart datafeed (PSX OHLCV)
sources.review_notes: OWNER DECISION 2026-11-08: owner authorised automated collection of PSX OHLCV from SCS's public chart datafeed (TradingView UDF protocol), accepting the legal risk, on condition of honest requests: the project's own User-Agent, no spoofed browser headers, no Referer, robots.txt respected (robots.txt returns 404). Evidence 2026-11-08: SCS publishes no API documentation or data terms; its site states 'All Rights Reserved'. Honest probe: /config, /symbols and /history for resolutions 1, 60, 240 and D all HTTP 200. Internal research use; bars are not redistributed.
sources.notes: Separate from the scstrade website/research source. Collected by collectors/market_ohlcv.py.
